title: Engine Version & Backend
description: mistralrs-server build to use, as <release>/<variant>. Versions are fetched from the configured GitHub repository and downloaded on demand.

title: Auto-Update Engine
description: Automatically download and switch to the newest release of the currently selected backend variant on startup.

title: Release Repository
description: GitHub repository (owner/repo) whose releases provide mistralrs-server binaries. Leave empty for the default.

title: Context Size
description: Maximum tokens in the context window (maps to max_seq_len). Larger values use more memory.

title: Model Data Type
description: Precision for model weights. 'Auto' picks the best type for your hardware. BF16 is recommended on Apple Silicon and Ampere+ GPUs; F16 on older GPUs.

title: Max Concurrent Sequences
description: Maximum sequences processed simultaneously by the scheduler. Increase for higher throughput when serving multiple clients.

title: Max Prompt Batch Size
description: Maximum prompt batch size used for automatic device mapping. 0 uses the server default.

title: GPU Layers
description: Number of model layers to offload to GPU/Metal. Leave empty for automatic mapping. Use a single number (e.g. '20') for one GPU, or 'ORD:NUM;...' for multiple GPUs (e.g. '0:20;1:16').

title: In-Situ Quantization (ISQ)
description: Quantize model weights after loading to reduce VRAM. Primarily useful for non-GGUF (safetensors) models; GGUF files are already quantized.

title: Tokenizer Model ID
description: HuggingFace model ID to load the tokenizer from (e.g. 'meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B'). Leave empty to use the tokenizer embedded in the GGUF file.

title: Prefix Cache Size
description: On-device KV-cache slots reserved for prompt prefixes. Repeated identical prefixes skip re-computation. Higher values improve speed but use more VRAM.

title: Seed
description: RNG seed for reproducible generation. Set to -1 for a random seed.

title: Disable KV Cache
description: Disabling the KV cache can reduce peak memory usage but will significantly slow down multi-turn conversations.

title: Force CPU Inference
description: Run inference on CPU only, disabling GPU/Metal acceleration. Useful for debugging or on machines without a supported GPU.

title: Enable PagedAttention (Metal)
description: Enable PagedAttention on Metal. PagedAttention is enabled by default on CUDA, so this only affects macOS.

title: Disable PagedAttention (CUDA)
description: Disable PagedAttention on CUDA GPUs. Try this if you hit allocation errors with large KV caches.

title: PagedAttention GPU Memory (MB)
description: GPU memory reserved for the PagedAttention KV cache in megabytes. 0 lets the server decide.

title: PagedAttention GPU Memory Fraction
description: Fraction (0–1] of free GPU memory to use for the PagedAttention KV cache. 0 lets the server decide.

title: PagedAttention Context Length
description: Total context length the PagedAttention KV cache is sized for. 0 lets the server decide.

title: PagedAttention Block Size
description: PagedAttention KV cache block size. 0 uses the server default (32).

title: PagedAttention Cache Type
description: KV cache element type for PagedAttention. F8E4M3 halves KV cache memory at slight quality cost.

title: Chat Template File
description: Path to a JINJA chat template file (or JSON with a chat_template key). Leave empty to use the model's own template.

title: Explicit JINJA Template
description: Path to an explicit JINJA chat template file taking precedence over everything else.

title: HuggingFace Token Source
description: Where to read the HuggingFace token from when fetching tokenizers: 'cache', 'env:VAR', 'path:file', 'literal:token' or 'none'. Leave empty for the default (cache).

title: Timeout
description: Model load and inference timeout in seconds.

title: Auto Unload Model
description: Automatically unload other models when loading a new one.
